description: WRITES. Fills a MARKET order in the caller's paper account, sized in units or in cash. Confirm symbol, side and size with the user first, then report the fill you got back. A sell cannot name a price; that is set_paper_bracket.

amount.description: Cash to commit, in ACCOUNT currency; units are derived from the fill price. On a 1:30 FX pair this is the MARGIN — the position is 30× it. Mutually exclusive with units.

stop_loss.description: BUY ORDERS ONLY — an exit level BELOW the fill price, per unit in the instrument's currency, riding along on the position this order opens. Sells the whole position when a daily close breaches it. Refused on a sell (a sell fills at the market now; use set_paper_bracket to exit at a level).

symbol.description: Exchange ticker, with a venue suffix for a non-US listing, e.g. 'AAPL', 'VUSA.L', 'SAP.DE'; FX as the 6-letter pair ('USDJPY'), indices by short code ('SPX'). Futures whose code is also a US listing go by their contract root behind a slash, the broker convention — /CL (WTI crude), /HG, /PL, /NG, /RB, /HO; coins by their USD pair (BTCUSD, ETHUSD); the MOVE index as MOVEINDEX; the bare code (WTI, HG, BTC…) means the listing. To sell a holding, pass the symbol get_paper_account shows for it.

take_profit.description: BUY ORDERS ONLY — an exit level ABOVE the fill price, per unit in the instrument's currency, riding along on the position this order opens. Sells the whole position when a daily close reaches it. Refused on a sell (a sell fills at the market now; use set_paper_bracket to exit at a level).

units.description: Exact quantity to trade (fractional allowed). Mutually exclusive with amount.

name: place_paper_order
